description: Source code for the ParquetScan class in Apache Spark, implementing data source scanning with pushdown and variant handling features.

classes.name: ParquetScan
classes.description: A case class implementing a file scan for Parquet data with support for pushdown filters, schema rewriting for variants, and aggregation pushdown.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Determines if the file at the given path can be split for parallel processing, considering pushed aggregation.

methods.name: effectiveReadDataSchema
methods.description: Computes the effective read schema, applying variant pushdown rewriting if necessary.

methods.name: rewriteVariantPushdownSchema
methods.description: Rewrites the schema to include variant extractions based on pushed variant extractions.

methods.name: rewriteType
methods.description: Recursively rewrites data types in the schema based on a mapping for variant extractions.

methods.name: readSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema to be used for reading, considering pushed down aggregations and variants.

methods.name: createReaderFactory
methods.description: Creates a PartitionReaderFactory configured with the effective schema and options for reading Parquet files.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, considering pushed aggregation, variant extractions, and filters.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the ParquetScan instance.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata about the scan, including pushed filters, aggregation, group by, and variant extractions.
